name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: This trial is a defining early lesson for paladins learning to serve the Holy Light, demonstrating that true devotion begins with humble charity rather than martial glory.
The mission highlights the domestic struggles within Stormwind and the shared ties with Ironforge as citizens strive to support vulnerable orphans amid economic strains.

aliases: what is the tome of divinity
why do the tome of divinity
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity is a foundational trial for aspiring paladins devoted to the Holy Light. Rather than demanding combat prowess or grand heroic feats, it directs initiates into the heart of Stormwind to seek out and assist someone pure of heart who genuinely needs aid.
faq.q: What is the purpose of The Tome of Divinity trial?

faq.answer: Stephanie Turner is a compassionate resident found in Stormwind's Trade District. She works tirelessly to sew clothing for the children residing at the local orphanage, relying on donations of cloth and leather to keep the young charges warm and cared for.

Her husband works alongside her to support the orphanage's needs. While Stephanie gathers supplies and sews clothes in Stormwind, her husband has traveled north to Ironforge to seek donations and assistance from the dwarven and gnomish populace.
faq.q: Why has Stephanie Turner's husband gone to Ironforge?

faq.answer: An influx of tradesmen in Stormwind has driven up competition for vital raw materials like cloth and leather. With fewer people willing to part with these resources freely, Stephanie finds it increasingly difficult to gather the materials required to make clothes for the orphans.
faq.q: What difficulties is Stephanie Turner facing?

aliases: why does the quest send you to stephanie
faq.answer: The trial requires an initiate of the Light to seek out someone with noble intent, pure motives, and a genuine need for a guiding hand. Stephanie Turner epitomizes selfless devotion to others, making her the ideal person for an aspiring servant of the Light to aid.
faq.q: Why does this trial specifically direct initiates to Stephanie Turner?

aliases: what does the light teach here
lesson of the tome of divinity
faq.answer: The trial instructs that walking the path of the Light requires compassion, selflessness, and service to the vulnerable. Before wielding holy power in battle, a champion of the Light must first understand the duty of kindness toward everyday citizens in need.
faq.q: What lesson does this trial impart to servants of the Light?

sections.body: The Tome of Divinity represents an essential spiritual rite of passage for initiates studying the ways of the Holy Light. Before receiving deeper instruction on holy duties, aspiring servants are tasked with walking the streets of Stormwind to find someone of noble intent and pure motive who depends upon the kindness of strangers. This test grounds sacred vows not in glorious combat, but in humble, attentive service to the vulnerable.
sections.title: A Lesson in Humility and Service

sections.body: In Stormwind's bustling Trade District, that duty leads initiates to Stephanie Turner. Alongside her husband, Stephanie dedicates her days to providing handmade clothing for the children residing in the city's orphanage. However, a recent surge of local tradesmen has created steep competition for raw cloth and leather, leaving the couple hard-pressed to secure donations. While her husband travels to the great dwarven halls of Ironforge to solicit support, Stephanie remains behind in Stormwind, continuing her quiet, selfless labor.
sections.title: Aid in the Trade District

summary: The Tome of Divinity is a foundational holy trial requiring initiates of the Light to seek out and assist a citizen of pure heart and noble motive in Stormwind. Directing champions to Stephanie Turner in the Trade District, the task emphasizes that true service begins with humble charity toward the vulnerable.
